metadata.nzzArticleSnippet: Das System Starlink verschafft der Ukraine eine stabile und leistungsstarke Internetverbindung und damit grosse Vorteile an der Front. Nun will Russland technologisch aufholen. Kiew versucht das zu verhindern.
metadata.teaserCaption: The Starlink system provides Ukraine with a stable and powerful internet connection, giving it significant advantages on the front lines. Now, Russia wants to catch up technologically. Kyiv is trying to prevent this.
metadata.leadText: The Starlink system provides Ukraine with a stable and powerful internet connection, giving it significant advantages on the front lines. Now, Russia wants to catch up technologically. Kyiv is trying to prevent this.
metadata.nzzSummaryEN:
• Russia is developing its own satellite-based communication system called Rasswjet to compete with Starlink, raising concerns for Ukraine.
• Ukraine has recently targeted a rocket factory of Russia's space agency to hinder progress on the Rasswjet project.
• While Russia's system currently has limited capabilities, the country plans a massive expansion with over 250 satellite launches next year.
metadata.nzzSummaryDE:
• Russia is developing its own satellite-based communications system called Rassvet to compete with Starlink, which is causing concern in Ukraine.
 • Ukraine recently attacked a rocket factory belonging to the Russian space agency in an attempt to hinder progress on the Rassvet project.
 • While Russia's system currently has limited capacity, the country is planning a massive expansion with over 250 satellite launches next year.
metadata.nzzPrintTitle: Kyiv targets the Russian space industry
metadata.nzzPrintSubtitle: Russia is developing an alternative to the Starlink satellite system – Ukraine wants to prevent this

metadata.title: This pilgrimage route explains why so many foreigners are affected by the flood disaster in Nepal
metadata.nzzSummaryEN:
- The flood disaster in Nepal affected a border crossing between Nepal and China, which serves as both an international pilgrimage route to Tibet and a significant trade route. 
- Many foreigners were impacted because this route is vital for regional goods imports and international pilgrimages.
metadata.nzzSummaryDE:
- The flood disaster in Nepal has hit a border crossing between Nepal and China, which is both an international pilgrimage route to Tibet and an important trade route.
 Many foreigners were affected, as this route is of international importance for regional goods imports and pilgrimages.
metadata.nzzPrintTitle: Floods and trade: The double tragedy at the border crossing
metadata.nzzPrintSubtitle: The flood disaster in Nepal affects pilgrimage route and trade route
